title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex and gas/flux source define nondimensional conservative gas equations and coefficient scaling.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: global_mesh.cpp reads TRI_3/QUAD_4, boundaries and Abutting1to1 zone links; MIXED and arbitrary general connectivity rejected.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Finite-volume face contributions with exchanged reconstruction implemented; low-Mach Re20 drag remains substantially under-predicted.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Roe/Harten and Rusanov fluxes implemented; report discloses low-Mach dissipation limitations and modified stiff-case settings.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic walls implemented; boundary flux uses cell-center state rather than reconstructed state.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: LSQ gradients and BJ/Venkat reconstruction exchanged over halos; saved stdout for steady production explicitly records second-order activation at step300.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: BJ/Venkat and positivity floors implemented, with disclosed first-order startup; accepted-state limiter frozen inside transient inner solve.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Corrected gradients, Newtonian/Fourier terms and tangential wall traction projection in solver.cpp:490–495; report notes coarse-wall limitations.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: SGS and optional GMRES; steady Cd-only window test can falsely accept changing lift, and transient target uses frozen limiter.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 fixed histories and full temporal term implemented; limiter frozen during inner test and no recheck after refresh, so fully refreshed target miss fraction is unknown.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Root-only METIS mesh preprocessing with neighbor state, gradient/limiter and correction halos; fixed-step Re20 rank diagnostics failed and differ ~9.7% np2 vs np4.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
